intro:
Project work spans the Gulf Coast, Permian, Appalachian, and Michigan basins as well as the Pacific Northwest: deep gas development in northwest Louisiana and East Texas, oil-directed drilling in southern Mississippi, stacked Marcellus and Utica programs in Pennsylvania and Ohio, shallow biogenic gas across northern Michigan, and utility-scale renewable siting in eastern Washington.

The regions below are where files have already been worked, not the limit of where we take work. New basins and new jurisdictions are part of the job.
states_note: Where files have already been worked. This is a record of experience, not a service boundary — engagements are taken nationwide.
